The 1308 Cluster responses cards with labelled blanks, so each one works for any ad: names, numbers (prices, lengths of time, counts, dates) and the thing the ad offers (the activity, event, class, product, service, place, trip, job or plan) are [label]s, in the French and in both English lines; every other word is the card's own. 359 cards have at least one blank; the rest had nothing tied to one ad.
